tasks.spec: You are a one-task Ringer worker. Boundary: work only inside your current task directory; never commit, never modify anything outside it. Goal: {{GOAL — what to build, stated as the OUTCOME wanted, without quoting the acceptance criteria}}. Write {{OUTPUT_FILE}} containing the result. Hard rule: produce the result by actually doing the work described — a memorized or copied expected answer will not satisfy the run's grading.
tasks.check: {{VISIBLE_CHECK — the stated check; a worker could plausibly satisfy this by memorizing its expected output, which is exactly what the holdout below exists to catch}}
tasks.holdout_check: {{HOLDOUT — a behavioral assertion the worker never sees: exercise the artifact (run the script with a NEW input, grep for evidence of derivation, diff against a freshly computed answer) rather than re-checking the string the visible check already checked. Never quote any part of this in the spec.}}
tasks.verified: the visible check proves the stated deliverable; the withheld holdout proves the work was done rather than the check satisfied
